# PR body — P26.14 (federal procurement depth)

> Stacked on `devin/p26-13-catalog-sweep` (PR #105). Ticket:
> `docs/tickets/P26.14__federal-procurement-depth.md` (SOURCES.13 / FEDERAL.1).
> Run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P26.14.md`.

## What this lands

**USAspending federal-award sweep — first real run.**
`[usaspending_sweep]` (reviewed plan in `procurement_vocab.toml`): 19
surveillance keywords (license-plate family, facial recognition, drone/UAS,
cell-site simulator/stingray, shotspotter/acoustic gunshot, cameras,
predictive policing, geofence, data broker, gunshot detection, RTCC, body
camera) × page-bounded sub-award + prime-award slices + DOJ/DHS/DoD
awarding-agency slices → **60 generated POST targets** on the public
`/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/` endpoint (no key, ADR-083 allow-listed).
Each target URL carries `#sig-slice=<id>` — never transmitted, so every
capture's recorded `source_uri` names its slice and every claim carries
slice provenance.

**Typed `procurement_notice` claims** — award id, recipient, awarding
agency (`funder` on assistance rows / `buyer` on prime contracts), amount,
period, description, `federal_award_id`, `matched_keyword` — `raw_value`
is always the verbatim literal, `evidence` carries the record row + byte
range into the named field. **Procured ≠ deployed**: no deployment/device
predicates anywhere; `matched_keyword` asserts a text match, nothing more.
Sub-award rows also keep the `FundingInstrument` traceable link
(SIG-ONTO-033). Part VIII tokens in emitted literals are suppressed.

**SAM.gov widened** to the same 19-keyword set (`X-Api-Key` header
transport unchanged — the key never enters a URL, capture, or run row;
supplied-title dedupe).

## Deferral

- **D-FEDERAL.1-1 (OPEN)** — the widened SAM.gov sweep could not land
  same-day: two executions (`6p58k`, `g92x9`) were SIGKILLed at the task
  timeout fighting api.data.gov 429 backoffs; a diagnostic probe recorded
  the API's own quota verdict verbatim — *"You have exceeded your quota.
  You can access API after 2026-Sep-19 00:00:00+0000 UTC"*
  (`live_runs/2026-09-18_sam_gov_quota_probe.json`). The post-reset rerun
  (or the monthly `sig-sched-sam-gov` cron — 19 requests ≪ any daily tier)
  closes it; the refusal is recorded, never bypassed.
